notes.title: New release coming soon...
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41581623/b81607bb25d00492d972a9bac1ac8f1a2616d8f8.png[/img]
[h1]🎨 My new game, Mewseum: Masterpieces, is coming soon![/h1]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614980/Square_Logic/][b]Square Logic[/b][/url], you’ll probably love this new release! In Mewseum: Masterpieces, every puzzle you solve reveals a piece of a famous painting, reimagined in the charming feline universe.

The game will feature relaxing puzzles with easy and medium difficulty levels, perfect for anyone looking to have fun without pressure.

notes.title: New Feature!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update a new feature is available! Now when right-clicking anywhere on the line, the path traced from this point will be deleted. This makes it easier to have to go back after drawing long paths.
It also avoids resetting the level to start from the beginning.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525365/98ea6b7ff64b734d53af6c9123298649655506fa.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525365/98ea6b7ff64b734d53af6c9123298649655506fa.gif[/img][/url]

Hope you like it!
Rodrigo Albuquerque
